name: Overlord / Command Suite / multi-node orchestration daemon

description.value:
The controller apex - one more node under your thumb than anyone else can manage.

  • Item Tier: T1
  • Availability: 1
  • Cost: ¥22,000
  • Profile: Program-mod (occupies 1 deck slot, persistent). Effect: Lets you hold one extra compromised node beyond your normal cap (deepens intrusion-momentum) and issue a held-node command as a maneuver.
  • Mod slots: 1 (deck slot)
  • Tags: Program, Wired

Item Tier sets price, Availability, and mod-slot count only — never raw power.
